page.overview:
Who is Wattson?

Wattson is the third Gym Leader of the Hoenn region. He is fought at Mauville City's Gym and specializes in -type Pokémon. He awards the player the Dynamo Badge when defeated.

Wattson is a short, chubby old man with receding white hair and a prominent spike sticking out. Wattson has a spiky white beard with a smile, for Wattson laughs a lot. He wears a yellow jumpsuit, with pockets on his hips.

Wattson wears a thick, long-sleeved pullover brown shirt, with a prominent dark ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem with a thunder logo on his sleeves. He also wears black shoes with light brown accents and soles.

Wattson's appearance remains the same as it is in Ruby and Sapphire.
